programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: A couple decides to sell their inherited farmland in Iowa and buy a cabin in Minnesota for family and friends to gather and celebrate holidays; for David, it's a chance to return to his childhood home to help them find a lakeside property.

programs.title: Renovation Resort
programs.desc: To complete their lake houses, the teams take on the biggest task yet: the living room & and deck; these expansive spaces must flow together seamlessly, bringing the indoors out and the outdoors in to create a true lakefront oasis; with the finish line in sight, the pressure is higher than ever, and just when they think they've got it handled, Scott & Bryan introduce a surprise extra space that no one saw coming.

programs.title: Sun, Sea and Selling Houses
programs.desc: Two British families set up shop in Spain to sell property to Britain families looking for a bit of fun in the sun.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: Mommy's Making It in Merida, Mexico
programs.desc: A single mom decides that her teenage daughter is old enough to uproot from Jamaica to Merida, Mexico. She has big dreams of exploring a new culture and growing her travel vlog, but finding a place downtown that's in her budget may be a challenge.

programs.title: Interior Design Masters
programs.desc: The designers head off to Scotland and arrive at the Mar Hall Hotel, a nineteenth century mansion now turned luxury resort; with just two days and a budget of two thousand pounds, the eight designers have their work cut out.
